scope: Attachment-inspired persistent memory plus candidate energy descent. Narrow frozen-teacher adapter experiment, not an EBT reproduction.
registered_at: Before all new adapter fitting and final scoring; cache extraction was already started.
teacher: archived 972896-parameter teacher; functional standalone reference; not actual 10.6M GB10 model
objective: CE averaged over 4 iterates for recurrent/energy; one CE for MLP controls. Exact analytic energy gradient differentiated end to end. No stop-gradient through candidate updates.
selection: Step zero and every100 updates, final-iterate validation bpb; best checkpoint. Select overall default family by mean validation before test. Inference-depth/tolerance choice uses validation only after checkpoints frozen.
primary: Paired same-position bpb against feedforward, memory_ff and recurrent controls; paired document bootstrap after averaging seeds
limitations: fixed compact memory reads are lossy
approximately equal trainable parameters, not total compute
retain: all failures, selected and final checkpoints, per-position predictions, source hashes and sampling hashes
